facts.fact: 她把 Core 的一块放进温室土里，在地表种 Void 植物，像养室内盆栽。
facts.anchor: After I put a piece of the Core in the greenhouse soil, I’ve been growing Void plants on the surface like they’re houseplants.

facts.fact: Calcy 的皮疹基本痊愈，新鲜 tassala 的效力是 Ms. Opal 旧药膏的十倍，她的恒牙开始长出来。
facts.anchor: Calcy’s skin has cleared up significantly, because the fresh tassala plant’s effects are ten times more powerful than the withered version Ms. Opal used for her lotion before. Calcy grins at me, her permanent front teeth starting to develop.

facts.fact: 卖 Obscuris 烟灰缸得了 20000 nox，加上 Void aloe 软膏的稳定收入，她买得起全新的医疗设备。
facts.anchor: From the 20,000 nox that Flint and I made from selling the Obscuris ashtray and the steady income from my Void aloe salves, I’ve been able to afford brand-new medical equipment.

facts.fact: Mr. Stone 给她的新义肢（左臂）由他的 limb guy 装上，是顶级的，机械手指灵活精确。
facts.anchor: the mechanical fingers of my left hand working as nimbly and precisely as my right. Mr. Stone set me up with his limb guy, so my new arm is top quality.

facts.fact: 孤儿院的新成员是二十磅重的小狗 Mango。
facts.anchor: Mango runs up to me, jumping and licking my hands⁠—twenty pounds of excited puppy love.

facts.fact: Flint 现在在铁匠铺打工，这天打了一把新的 Damascus steel 钢刀。
facts.anchor: I got to make a new Damascus steel blade. I’ll have to show you the next time you come in.”

facts.fact: Flint 在厨房转角捧住她的脸吻她，是她一直梦想的样子。
facts.anchor: he cups my cheek and kisses me, his lips soft, warm, purposeful against mine⁠—and it’s everything I’d always dreamed it would be.

facts.fact: Mr. Stone 认为这个计划疯狂又危险，但如果有可信的人手，也许可行。
facts.anchor: “He thinks it’s crazy too. Horribly dangerous. Thinks we could get killed just by asking too many questions, but with a trustworthy crew, it might be possible.”

facts.fact: Flint 问她是否确定、声明不想让她因为这是自己的想法而有压力；她回答这主意也是她的。
facts.anchor: “You’re sure you want to? I don’t want you feeling pressured just because it’s my idea.”

facts.fact: 两人决定杀光所有 surfacewalker，并说这会让世界变得更好。
facts.anchor: “We’re going to kill every last surfacewalker.”

facts.fact: Flint 在诊所里高烧、脉急，肺部发出可怕的杂音。
facts.anchor: His skin is so hot, his pulse so quick. His lungs make that awful rattle.

facts.fact: Petra 皮下有东西在蠕动生长，最后一根藤蔓从她指尖探出来——她也被感染了。
facts.anchor: Something moves beneath my skin, snaking, growing. As the light gets closer, I hold my hand up.
